justifications.type_expressiveness: Uses a well-structured enum with meaningfully distinct variants carrying relevant data (OutOfRange(u32), InvalidChar(char)), though the (u32, &str) tuple table could be a typed struct.
justifications.error_handling: Typed enum with four meaningfully distinct variants, no panics in library paths, and the only unwrap()s are documented as safe after prior validation.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface with complete doc comments, sensible derives (Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Clone), Display impl, and naming consistent with std conventions.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with a clean greedy table and iterator validation, but the second pass uses index-based while loops and Vec<char> collection rather than a windowed iterator approach.
